name: mdflow
description: Keep project architecture, implementation progress, checkpoints, and code references synchronized through a task-scoped graph.

interface.shortDescription: Task-scoped project context and live architecture sync.
interface.longDescription: Read only the project context needed for the current task, then keep blocks, chains, links, code references, progress, and checkpoints synchronized as the implementation changes.
capabilities: Verified AST mutation with source-drift protection
defaultPrompt: Use mdflow to understand this task and keep its project graph synchronized.
